bio.text: Armen Kurdian is the Republican candidate for California's 49th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Mike Levin.

In the biography Kurdian submitted to Ballotpedia, Kurdian described being a retired Navy captain with over 25 years of service, during which Kurdian led large civil, military and union organizations.
Kurdian said that after retiring, Kurdian continued community service in local nonprofits and serving local government.
